text: I heard them in the hall. Scratching at the wainscot like rats. Thirty years I have not been this afraid.
I was at Verdun, you know. Nineteen sixteen. ...The dead stayed down at Verdun.
A Karabiner. A ninety-eight. ...My hands remember. Go on, go. I'll hold the hall.
Stop! Stop, don't shoot... we're alive. We're alive in here. You came up the stairs... are they behind you?
Don't let me get up again. Promise me. Don't let me get up.
I'm down... the leg's gone. Don't leave an old man on the floor!
Coming along the hall! I have him!
It has my coat... get off me!
